There is no official ethnic demographic data. Ethnic composition for DUN Nilai and DUN Bagan Pinang have Malay share is more than 1% higher than April 2025 statistics of Election Lab (hence data may need further scrutinisation). The demographics data for Age Categories, Voter Type and Sex Category refers to April 2026 Electoral Roll (but not identical to the one used for Negeri Sembilan 2026 Electoral Roll). Urbanisation level is derived from Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL) and subsequently computed by Tindak Malaysia for final urbanisation levels for each DUN. OKU Vote Count refers to total voters who are registered people with disabililty (OKU) and it is based on the principal electoral roll of 2025 (not reflective of 2026 electoral roll for Negeri Sembilan elections).
